caseName: Emporium Capwell Co. v. Western Addition Community Organization
caseNameFull: Emporium Capwell Co. v. Western Addition Community Organization and National Labor Relations Board v. Western Addition Community Organization

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. [Certiorari granted, 415 U. S. 913.] Motion of the Solicitor General for additional time for oral argument granted and 15 additional minutes are allotted for that purpose. Respondents also allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument. Motion of National Retail Merchants Assn., Inc., for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted.
